SELECT s.r_reason_desc_prefix AS substr,
       avg(s.ws_quantity),
       avg(s.wr_refunded_cash),
       avg(s.wr_fee)
FROM (
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           rs.r_reason_desc,
           substr(rs.r_reason_desc, 1, 20) AS r_reason_desc_prefix
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_dim AS d
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 1998
    JOIN web_page AS wp
      ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns AS wr
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
     AND cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
     AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
     AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D'
     AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    JOIN customer_address AS ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
     AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
     AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
    JOIN reason AS rs
      ON rs.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
      AND (
          (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
          OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
          OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           rs.r_reason_desc,
           substr(rs.r_reason_desc, 1, 20) AS r_reason_desc_prefix
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_dim AS d
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 1998
    JOIN web_page AS wp
      ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns AS wr
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
     AND cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
     AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
     AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'S'
     AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN customer_address AS ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
     AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
     AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
    JOIN reason AS rs
      ON rs.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
      AND (
          (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
          OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
          OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           rs.r_reason_desc,
           substr(rs.r_reason_desc, 1, 20) AS r_reason_desc_prefix
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_dim AS d
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 1998
    JOIN web_page AS wp
      ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns AS wr
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
     AND cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
     AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
     AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'U'
     AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
    JOIN customer_address AS ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
     AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
     AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
    JOIN reason AS rs
      ON rs.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
      AND (
          (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
          OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
          OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )
) AS s
GROUP BY s.r_reason_desc, s.r_reason_desc_prefix
ORDER BY s.r_reason_desc_prefix, avg(s.ws_quantity), avg(s.wr_refunded_cash), avg(s.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
